verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair axis for a SaaS collaboration platform with developer APIs, but nothing in the evidence documents one, such as a developer tenant or test site isolated from production. The Graph `$whatif` parameter only reveals the underlying SharePoint URL; it is not a dry-run or sandbox. Recycle-bin behavior is an adjacent feature, and an admin setting up a separate installation is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
